summary: John's 3rd great-grandfather; Irish-born iron-furnace helper at Danville, PA.
bio: Edward McGuire was born about 1824 in Ireland and died Apr 1907, buried Plymouth. In the 1870 census, Mahoning Twp., Montour Co. (P.O. Danville), he was a 'furnace helper' with wife Mary Jane and children Edward 14, Mary 12, James 9, 'Mesilla' 5 and Timothy 3, all born PA — so in Pennsylvania by c.1856/1858. Danville was home of the Montour Iron Works, whose rolling mill is credited with the first T-rails in America (1845). FamilySearch claims he was baptized 7 Apr 1824 at St. Mary's, Haddington Road (Donnybrook), Dublin, son of Owen McGuire and Anne Clusky, with a sister Margaret baptized Jan 1819 ('Ireland, Catholic Parish Registers' index; image not released) — nothing ties the Danville furnace hand to this baptism beyond name and year.
